lastText: The Case Is ClosedThe Reichenbach FallNew Ending Discovered · 1 / 16A BROTHER IN BLACKMycroft is told by telegram, and arrives in Meiringen on the fourth day, in a closed carriage, a great grey presence at the edge of the gorge. He says nothing at all. He looks at the water for a long while, and then at the stick, and then he asks the guides, courteously, to leave him alone. When Watson finds him he is sitting on the wet rock with his hat in his hands. It is the only time that anyone has seen the elder Holmes brother without his composure. In the years that follow, the world remembers a man who kept his friends about him, and who was kinder than he allowed.
